app.title: ReBarUEFI: Resizable BAR for almost any UEFI system
app.author: nateb2022
app.description: A command-line utility that patches UEFI firmware to enable Resizable BAR (Base Address Register) support on a wide range of systems, improving GPU memory allocation.
proposed_tests: Clone the repository and run `cargo build --release` to compile the tool.
Execute `./rebardeuifile --help` to confirm the CLI interface is functional.
Create a copy of a test UEFI image, run the tool to enable Resizable BAR, and verify the resulting image contains the expected ACPI table modifications.
Flash the modified UEFI image onto a virtual machine (e.g., QEMU) and check that the GPU reports increased memory range.
Measure the time taken for the patching process and compare it against a baseline of manual firmware modification.
